# Penguin (`waddle`)

A little penguin on an LED panel: it waddles, waves, belly-slides, dances and dozes.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: clock
- Cost: light (~2.7 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Penguin
